kinds.name: seq
kinds.answers: FAILURE at the first child that fails, RUNNING while one is, SUCCESS when all have succeeded
kinds.doc: its children in order; resumes at the child that was RUNNING

kinds.name: select
kinds.answers: the answer of the first child that does not fail; FAILURE when all fail
kinds.doc: its children in order, the first that does not fail: a priority list; resumes at the child that was RUNNING

kinds.name: pick

params.name: every
params.doc: seconds between two choices; it also chooses again whenever the option chosen ends

params.name: sticky
params.doc: the option being done is worth this much more, as a fraction of its own worth

params.name: noise
params.doc: luck: each option's worth is multiplied by a draw within 1 +- this

kinds.answers: the answer of the option chosen; FAILURE when no option has a score above 0
kinds.doc: a weighed choice among its options: the one worth most to this bot (score x trait weight x factor x luck) is ticked

kinds.name: option

params.name: trait
params.doc: whose character weighs it: the bot's weight for this trait multiplies the score

params.name: score
params.doc: what bears on it: a score of the vocabulary, 0 to 1; at 0 the option cannot be chosen

params.name: factor
params.doc: the designer's thumb on the scale

kinds.doc: one choice of a pick: `option <trait> <score> [score's arguments] [x<factor>]`, only directly under a pick

kinds.name: if
kinds.answers: SUCCESS if the condition holds, else FAILURE
kinds.doc: a condition of the vocabulary, with its arguments

kinds.name: unless
kinds.answers: FAILURE if the condition holds, else SUCCESS
kinds.doc: a condition, the other way round

kinds.name: do
kinds.answers: the action's: RUNNING while it goes on, SUCCESS or FAILURE when it ends
kinds.doc: an action of the vocabulary, with its arguments; stopped (told once) if its branch is abandoned while it is RUNNING

kinds.name: wait

params.name: seconds
params.doc: how long, from the first tick that reaches it

kinds.answers: RUNNING for that long, then SUCCESS

kinds.name: invert
kinds.answers: its child's turned: SUCCESS for FAILURE, FAILURE for SUCCESS; RUNNING stays

kinds.name: always
kinds.answers: SUCCESS whatever the child answers; RUNNING stays
kinds.doc: do the child and go on whatever came of it

kinds.name: never
kinds.answers: FAILURE whatever the child answers; RUNNING stays
kinds.doc: do the child and fail whatever came of it

kinds.name: cooldown

params.name: seconds
params.doc: how long after the child answers SUCCESS or FAILURE

kinds.answers: its child's; then FAILURE, without asking the child, for that long after the child ended

kinds.name: limit

params.name: seconds
params.doc: how long the child may stay RUNNING

kinds.answers: its child's; FAILURE if the child is still RUNNING after that long (the child is stopped)

kinds.name: tree
kinds.answers: the answer of the tree named
kinds.doc: another tree by name, as if written here; `items` and `extras` are written by the engine

conditions.name: enemy_visible
conditions.doc: an enemy is in this bot's sight now

conditions.name: enemy_known
conditions.doc: an enemy is in sight, remembered, or told of by the team

conditions.name: enemy_within
conditions.doc: the nearest enemy in sight is nearer than that

conditions.name: enemy_beyond
conditions.doc: an enemy is in sight and the nearest is farther than that

conditions.name: enemies_grouped
conditions.doc: that many known enemies stand within radius of one another

conditions.name: target_in_cover
conditions.doc: the man being fought was seen under 5 s ago and is out of sight now

conditions.name: outnumbered
conditions.doc: more enemies in sight than team-mates within 20, itself included

conditions.name: health_below
conditions.doc: its health is under that (of 100)

conditions.name: hurt_recently
conditions.doc: it lost health within that many seconds (default 3)

conditions.name: ammo_below
conditions.doc: rounds left, magazine and reserve, are under that fraction of a full load

conditions.name: ammo_out
conditions.doc: no round left at all

conditions.name: has_grenade
conditions.doc: it carries a grenade

conditions.name: grenade_worth
conditions.doc: it has a grenade, is not just done throwing, and something is worth one (a group, a far man, a place just lost)

conditions.name: grenade_near
conditions.doc: an enemy grenade it has noticed would hurt it where it stands

conditions.name: heard_noise
conditions.doc: a noise it heard is still worth going to

conditions.name: lost_enemy
conditions.doc: somebody left its sight and the place is still fresh

conditions.name: has_search
conditions.doc: there is a place worth searching: a lost man, a hit's source, a noise, a told sighting

conditions.name: alert
conditions.doc: its alertness is that

conditions.name: ping_called
conditions.doc: a team-mate's ping was given to this bot to answer (of that kind, if said)

conditions.name: has_order
conditions.doc: the server gave it an order that stands

conditions.name: is_night
conditions.doc: it is night

conditions.name: has_night_vision
conditions.doc: it sees by night as by day (the setting night_vision)

conditions.name: lamp_on
conditions.doc: its flashlight is lit

conditions.name: has_item
conditions.doc: it holds at least one of that inventory item

conditions.name: sky_clear
conditions.doc: nothing solid above its head (a thing that comes down from the sky needs it)

conditions.name: allies_hurt_near
conditions.doc: a team-mate under 50 health is within radius

conditions.name: mate_within
conditions.doc: a live team-mate is that near

conditions.name: alone
conditions.doc: no live team-mate within that (default 25)

conditions.name: spotted_new
conditions.doc: it has just seen an enemy its team did not know of

conditions.name: losing
conditions.doc: it is in a fight, under 45 health and outnumbered, or under 30 and just hit

conditions.name: sniped
conditions.doc: it was hit within 3 s from more than 50 voxels away

conditions.name: setting

args.name: value
args.default_note: any value: the setting is set

conditions.doc: the gamemode's setting <key> is set (to <value>, if said): how a mode's tree reads the mode's own rules

conditions.name: chance
conditions.doc: true that often, by the bot's own dice

conditions.name: knows
conditions.doc: the bot knows of such a place now

conditions.name: at
conditions.doc: it is within that of the place (default 4)

conditions.name: gun_is
conditions.doc: its gun is one of those named

conditions.name: under_fire
conditions.doc: it was shot at within that many seconds (default 3): hurt by somebody, a round that passed within 2.5 voxels, a team-mate killed within 12

conditions.name: in_cover
conditions.doc: what threatens it (the man it fights, where a hit came from) has no line of sight to its body as it stands

conditions.name: in_harmful_water
conditions.doc: it is wading in water that hurts (the settings water=lethal or water.damage)

conditions.name: carrying_intel
conditions.doc: it carries the other team's intel

conditions.name: their_intel_home
conditions.doc: the other team's intel lies where the server put it

conditions.name: their_intel_dropped
conditions.doc: the other team's intel lies where a carrier of this team fell

conditions.name: their_intel_carried
conditions.doc: a team-mate carries the other team's intel

conditions.name: our_intel_home
conditions.doc: this team's intel lies where the server put it

conditions.name: our_intel_dropped
conditions.doc: this team's intel lies where its thief fell (it cannot be picked up by its own team: it is guarded there)

conditions.name: our_intel_taken
conditions.doc: an enemy carries this team's intel (where he is is known to everybody: the place `thief`)

conditions.name: near_own_base
conditions.doc: it is within that of its team's base (default 20)

conditions.name: near_their_base
conditions.doc: it is within that of the other team's base (default 20)

conditions.name: mates_near
conditions.doc: that many live team-mates (default 1) are within radius

conditions.name: is_leader
conditions.doc: it is one of its team's leaders (drawn by lot by the engine; it is not told otherwise)

conditions.name: has_leader
conditions.doc: it follows a living leader of its team: a bot or a person, the nearest with room (a loner never does)

conditions.name: leader_near
conditions.doc: its leader is within that (default 12)

conditions.name: leader_fighting
conditions.doc: its leader has a man in his sights, is firing, or was hurt in the last 3 s

conditions.name: watched
conditions.doc: that many team-mates (default 2), not counting itself, are on guard (the action `guard`) within radius (default 20) of the place (default own_intel)

scores.name: night_vision
scores.doc: 1 by night for a bot that has night vision

scores.name: hit_in_dark
scores.doc: 1 by night for a bot with no night vision that was hit in the last 8 s

scores.name: enemy_visible
scores.doc: 1 with an enemy in sight, else 0

scores.name: enemy_known
scores.doc: how sure it is of an enemy it cannot see: 1 fresh, fading to 0; 0 with one in sight

scores.name: enemy_near
scores.doc: 1 with an enemy in sight at arm's length, falling to 0 at that distance (default 60)

scores.name: hurt
scores.doc: health lost: 0 unhurt, 1 nearly dead

scores.name: hurt_in_fight
scores.doc: health lost, counted only with an enemy in sight or a hit from somewhere in the last 3 s; 0 for 6 s after a retreat

scores.name: healthy
scores.doc: health left, 0 to 1

scores.name: search
scores.doc: how fresh the place most worth searching is: 1 just now, 0 none

scores.name: ping_called
scores.doc: 1 while a team-mate's ping is this bot's to answer

scores.name: has_order
scores.doc: 1 while an order stands

scores.name: alone
scores.doc: 0 beside a team-mate, rising to 1 at that distance (default 40) or with none alive

scores.name: grenade_worth
scores.doc: 1 when a grenade is worth throwing now (see the condition)

scores.name: grenade_near
scores.doc: 1 when an enemy grenade would hurt it here

scores.name: outnumbered
scores.doc: 0 when not; else how badly, up to 1

scores.name: night
scores.doc: 1 by night

scores.name: calm
scores.doc: 1 when nothing is known, 0.3 when suspicious, 0 engaged

scores.name: has_item
scores.doc: 1 if it holds one

scores.name: ammo_low
scores.doc: 0 with a full load, 1 with none

scores.name: gun_is
scores.doc: 1 if its gun is one of those named, else 0

scores.name: under_fire
scores.doc: 1 just shot at (see the condition), falling to 0 over that many seconds (default 4)

scores.name: pressed
scores.doc: how hard pressed in a fight: three parts health lost, one part enemies in sight beyond the team-mates within 20; 0 with nobody in sight and no round for 4 s

scores.name: standoff
scores.doc: 1 when the nearest enemy in sight is within half its gun's opening range and farther than it would close to: one to stand and shoot at

scores.name: enemy_far
scores.doc: 0 with an enemy in sight at arm's length, rising to 1 at that distance (default 60); 0 with none in sight

scores.name: mate_near
scores.doc: 1 beside a team-mate, falling to 0.2 at that distance (default 40); 0 with none alive or one it just gave up following

scores.name: harmful_water
scores.doc: 1 while it wades in water that hurts

scores.name: flank_open
scores.doc: 1 when the enemy's area (where the team last met him, else his base) is over 45 away and it has not just flanked

scores.name: rumour
scores.doc: how fresh the freshest rumour of the enemy is -- a noise it heard, a team-mate's sighting, the team's last meeting -- that is over 10 away and it has not just been to: 1 just now, 0 none

scores.name: vantage
scores.doc: 1 when the team knows a perch nobody has claimed (high, a long view toward the enemy, a way up) and its gun is one of those named (any, when none is)

scores.name: carrying_intel
scores.doc: 1 while it carries the other team's intel

scores.name: their_intel_home
scores.doc: 1 while the other team's intel lies where the server put it

scores.name: their_intel_dropped
scores.doc: 1 while it lies where a carrier fell

scores.name: their_intel_carried
scores.doc: 1 while a team-mate carries it

scores.name: our_intel_home
scores.doc: 1 while this team's intel lies where the server put it

scores.name: our_intel_dropped
scores.doc: 1 while it lies where its thief fell

scores.name: our_intel_taken
scores.doc: 1 while an enemy carries it

scores.name: near_own_base
scores.doc: 1 at its team's base, falling to 0 at that distance (default 40)

scores.name: near_their_base
scores.doc: 1 at the other team's base, falling to 0 at that distance (default 40)

scores.name: mates_near
scores.doc: 0 with no team-mate within radius, 1 with three or more

scores.name: is_leader
scores.doc: 1 for a leader, else 0: for a tree to lean a leader toward going somewhere

scores.name: has_leader
scores.doc: 1 while it follows a living leader, else 0

scores.name: quiet
scores.doc: 1 once it has had no enemy in sight for that many seconds of this life (default 20), else 0

scores.name: unwatched
scores.doc: how short of team-mates a place is (default own_intel, within 20): 1 with none there, 0.5 with one, 0 with two or more; 0 with no such place

scores.name: unguarded

args.name: only
args.default_note: whatever its state, but for one somebody carries

scores.doc: 1 while fewer than count team-mates (default 2) are on guard within radius (default 20) of the place (default own_intel), else 0; 0 for an intel somebody carries; with the word `dropped`, only while that intel lies where a carrier fell

actions.name: crouch

args.name: secs
args.default_note: the flinch: 0.3 to 1 s by its caution, once for a burst of fire

actions.doc: down where it stands, turned to what shot at it, shooting if it sees him. With no time said it is the flinch: 0.3 to 1 s by character, once for a burst of fire (asked again it succeeds at once)

actions.name: take_cover
actions.doc: to the best cover from what threatens it (near, well hidden, a way out behind, no team-mate in it); there crouched if the cover is low, facing the threat, peeking to fire -- rarely and long for the careful, hardly stopping for the bold. No cover in reach: crouched where it stands, turned to the threat. SUCCESS after its time there (0.8 to 14 s by character); FAILURE with no threat

actions.name: advance_by_cover

args.name: radius
args.default_note: at the enemy, with no radius said: its own fighting distance

actions.doc: toward a place (default: the enemy) from cover to cover, a pause at each by character; a run where no cover gains ground. SUCCESS there (at a man: at its own fighting distance); FAILURE no such place, no way

actions.name: fall_back_by_cover
actions.doc: away from what threatens it toward a place (default own_base; with none, straight away), from cover to cover, not firing. SUCCESS out of sight with no round for 3 s, or there; FAILURE with no threat

actions.name: seek
actions.doc: go and find the enemy: to his base by the direct way, shooting what it meets; there and nobody, on to where the team last met him, then back as far as the middle, and round again. With no bases, or no way to his, it roams. Always RUNNING: a tree's last resort

actions.name: flank
actions.doc: to the place (default: the enemy's area) the long way round, by a side of its own choosing, so as to come at it from behind. SUCCESS there; FAILURE too near to go round, no ground either side, no way

actions.name: hunt_noise
actions.doc: go to the freshest rumour of the enemy (see the score). SUCCESS on seeing the place from near; FAILURE none, no way

actions.name: take_high_ground
actions.doc: claim the best free perch for its gun and go up to it. SUCCESS on it; FAILURE none free, no way up

actions.name: camp

args.name: secs
args.default_note: its patience: 25 to 120 s by its caution and marksmanship

actions.doc: stay where it is, crouched, sweeping the arc toward the enemy, firing at what appears. SUCCESS after two kills, when shot at, or when its patience is out (25 to 120 s by character, or secs): it then gives up its perch and takes another next time

actions.name: leave_water
actions.doc: to the nearest dry ground. SUCCESS dry; RUNNING on the way; FAILURE none within 48

actions.name: fetch
actions.doc: go to the other team's intel where it lies and walk onto it (the server gives it to whoever of the other team stands within 3 of it). SUCCESS carrying it; FAILURE none, somebody has it, no way

actions.name: carry_home
actions.doc: the carrier runs for its own base by a route that keeps away from the enemies it knows of, shooting only at a man within 14. RUNNING while it carries; SUCCESS when it no longer does; FAILURE no base, no way

actions.name: escort
actions.doc: stay by the team-mate who carries the intel: ahead of him toward the base and to a side, shooting what it sees. RUNNING; FAILURE nobody carries

actions.name: intercept
actions.doc: cut off the enemy who carries this team's intel: to the point of his way home it can reach before he does, and fight him on sight. RUNNING; FAILURE nobody has it

actions.name: guard
actions.doc: hold near a place (default own_intel) at a spot of its own on the side the enemy comes from, crouched if careful, watching that way, shooting what appears. SUCCESS after secs (default 30); FAILURE no such place, no way

actions.name: fight
actions.doc: fight the enemy it has chosen (nearest in sight, kept until another is at half his distance): close to its own range, strafe, burst, reload, spade when it comes to that. RUNNING while he lives; SUCCESS on his death; FAILURE with nobody

actions.name: go_to
actions.doc: walk to a place (jumping, digging, bridging as the mode allows), shooting what it meets on the way. SUCCESS there, FAILURE with no such place or no way

actions.name: retreat
actions.doc: run to the nearest place the enemy cannot see, back turned. SUCCESS hidden (or after 10 s), FAILURE with nothing to run from

actions.name: investigate
actions.doc: go to the place most worth searching, look round it, then forget it. SUCCESS looked, FAILURE none or no way

actions.name: roam
actions.doc: walk to somewhere the team has not been lately: round where the enemy was last met, else between the two bases, else anywhere -- not round its own base. Always RUNNING: what a bot does in a world with nothing to seek

actions.name: follow
actions.doc: keep a station 3 voxels from a player: the nearest team-mate who is going somewhere (default), the caller of the ping it answers, or the order's man. `leader`: fall in with its leader -- beside and behind him, never in front of his gun; where he is going, not at his heels; shooting what he shoots; stopping near him when he stops. RUNNING; FAILURE with nobody, or a man who stays put too long

actions.name: hold
actions.doc: go to the place (default: here) and watch from it, sweeping the head, crouched if careful. SUCCESS after secs (default 8)

actions.name: throw_grenade

args.name: place
args.default_note: what is worth one: a group, a far man, a place just lost

actions.doc: throw at the place, or at what is worth one: stands, turns to the arc, lets go. SUCCESS thrown, FAILURE no arc, too near, none left

actions.name: evade
actions.doc: run from the grenade that threatens it. RUNNING until it has burst

actions.name: ping
actions.doc: ping the place for the team with one of the mode's labels ("Enemy", "Need help", "Sniper"). SUCCESS sent; FAILURE when the team has such a ping there, it pinged lately, or it is not one to say (teamwork)

actions.name: use

args.name: guide_secs
args.default_note: the item's own guide time (the setting item.<name>.guide), else none

actions.doc: use an inventory item, on itself or aimed at a point (the server's "inv <item> [x y z]"). With `enemy` and a guide time the head stays on that man for it. SUCCESS asked; FAILURE none held, just used, nothing to aim at

actions.name: lamp
actions.doc: flashlight: lit, out (as a bot starts), or auto (lit by night). Never lit by day. SUCCESS at once

actions.name: obey
actions.doc: do what the server's order says: go, hold, hunt a player, follow one. FAILURE with no order, SUCCESS when it is done

actions.name: look_around
actions.doc: stand and look left, right and behind. SUCCESS after three looks

actions.name: reload
actions.doc: reload now if the magazine is not full. SUCCESS asked, FAILURE nothing to do

traits.name: none
traits.doc: always 1: an option nobody's character moves

traits.name: aggression
traits.doc: take the fight, close the distance

traits.name: caution
traits.doc: cover, retreat when hurt, keep range

traits.name: objective
traits.doc: the intel, the point, the tower -- the game

traits.name: teamwork
traits.doc: answer pings, escort, stay with the others

traits.name: builder
traits.doc: dig and build rather than walk round

traits.name: marksman
traits.doc: fight from far, hold an angle

traits.name: stealth
traits.doc: sneak, lamp out, do not be heard

traits.name: curiosity
traits.doc: go and look: noises, last-seen places

traits.name: greed
traits.doc: use what it holds: items, grenades

archetypes.name: camper
archetypes.doc: careful and a marksman: holds an angle, keeps its distance, seldom goes in

archetypes.name: pusher
archetypes.doc: bold and keen on the game: straight at the enemy and at the objective

archetypes.name: flanker
archetypes.doc: goes round, and quietly: comes at the enemy from where he is not looking

archetypes.name: support
archetypes.doc: with the others: answers their calls, escorts, digs and builds for them

archetypes.name: sapper
archetypes.doc: digs and builds rather than walk round

archetypes.name: scout
archetypes.doc: curious and quiet: goes to look at what it heard, alone if need be

places.name: self
places.doc: where it stands

places.name: enemy
places.doc: the man it fights, else the nearest in sight, else the nearest it knows of

places.name: group
places.doc: the middle of two or more known enemies within 6 of one another

places.name: last_seen
places.doc: where somebody left its sight, while that is fresh

places.name: noise
places.doc: what it heard, while that is fresh

places.name: threat
places.doc: where a hit seemed to come from, in the last 8 s

places.name: search
places.doc: the place most worth searching: the freshest of the last three, or a sighting it was told of

places.name: ping
places.doc: the ping it answers (the caller himself for a call for help)

places.name: caller
places.doc: the one whose ping it answers, where he is now

places.name: order
places.doc: where the server's order points (the man, for an order to hunt or follow)

places.name: mate
places.doc: the nearest team-mate

places.name: leader
places.doc: the leader it follows

places.name: cover
places.doc: the nearest place the enemy, or what last hit it, cannot see

places.name: hot
places.doc: where its team last met the other, in the last minute

places.name: enemy_area
places.doc: where the enemy is expected: `hot`, else his base

places.name: rumour
places.doc: the freshest rumour of the enemy (the score `rumour`)

places.name: vantage
places.doc: the best free perch for its gun

places.name: own_base
places.doc: its team's base

places.name: enemy_base
places.doc: the other team's base

places.name: own_intel
places.doc: its team's intel, where it is now

places.name: enemy_intel
places.doc: the other team's intel, where it is now

places.name: thief
places.doc: the enemy who carries this team's intel (the world shows a carrier to everybody)

places.name: carrier
places.doc: the team-mate who carries the other team's intel

places.name: intercept
places.doc: where to cut the thief off on his way home
